chunks: And al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

He was asked about a man to whom travel presents itself during the Month of Ramadan while he is resident, and some days of it have already passed. So he said, “There is no harm in his traveling, breaking his fast, and not fasting.”

key_terms.السَّفَرُ: travel that affects the ruling of fasting
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, during which sawm is ordinarily obligatory
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.مُقِيمٌ: resident, not yet in a state of travel
key_terms.يُفْطِرَ: to break the fast or not maintain the fast

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to travel during the Month of Ramadan after having already fasted some days?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who is resident during Ramadan, then finds a reason to travel after some days of the month have passed. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that there is no harm in such a person traveling and not fasting during the سفر.
